I added a 0.25s pause between the sandbox calls in `tests/test_payments.py`. I haven't run the test, since it calls the live sandbox.

- **What changed:** `test_charges_roundtrip` now waits `SANDBOX_CALL_INTERVAL_S = 0.25` seconds before each request after the first. At 5 requests per second the minimum gap is 0.2s, so 0.25s leaves some room. The test gets about 0.75s slower.
- **Remaining risk:** the sleep keeps this one test under the limit, but it can't help if other CI jobs use the same sandbox credentials at the same time. Their requests would add up against the same 5 per second. If the flakes continue, the next step is to retry on 429 ("too many requests") responses with a backoff.

I also saved the 5-requests-per-second limit to project memory as a hazard, so future work on sandbox tests will see it.
